name: OMathAutoCorrectEntry
description: Represents an individual entry in the OMathAutoCorrectEntry collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathAutoCorrectEntry object.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the position of an item in a collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets a String that represents the name of an equation auto correct entry. Read/write.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Returns or sets a String that represents the contents of an equation auto correct entry. Read/write.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified equation auto correct entry.
